input: Track my daily water intake for one month

gold.taskTitle: Track Daily Water Intake for One Month
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to monitor and record their daily water consumption consistently over a 30-day period.

questions.title: What is your daily water intake goal in liters or ounces?
questions.description: Understand the target amount the user is aiming to drink each day.

questions.title: Which method will you use to track intake?
questions.description: Determine whether the user prefers a mobile app, paper journal, spreadsheet, or another method.

questions.title: What specific date do you want to start?
questions.description: Establish the exact start date so the 30-day window is clearly defined.

questions.title: How many times per day will you log your intake?
questions.description: Find out if the user plans to log after every drink, at set intervals, or just once at day's end.

questions.title: Do you count coffee, tea, or other beverages toward your total?
questions.description: Clarify which types of drinks will be included in the daily water intake count.

questions.title: What is motivating you to track water intake now?
questions.description: Understand the underlying reason, such as health goals, doctor advice, or fitness training, to tailor the plan.

questions.title: How will you remind yourself to log each entry?
questions.description: Identify whether the user needs reminders set up via phone alarms, app notifications, or another cue.
